_comment: Card progression settings for the offline server (see games/ssomg/re/notes/06-progression.md). Copied to server-data/progression.json by tools/build-server-data.py. Grades: 0=C 1=B 2=A 3=S 4=R. Difficulties: 0=easy 1=normal 2=hard. Values below come from SUPERSTAR LOONA's own master data (v260) unless a _why says otherwise.

start._why: LOONA's client has the same tutorial reward tag tutorialNormalCardPack30 (il2cpp string literals), i.e. a normal 30-card pack; no table gives a different size. Given at save creation so there's always a leader card. headphone/maxCardInventory are offline choices, as in SSOMG/SSGF.

rpPerSong._why: PLACEHOLDER formula (same as SSOMG). LOONA's GameConfigData has the same constants: RP_BONUS (15401)=165, RP_BONUS_REVISION (15402)=15000, RP_BONUS_EASY/NORMAL/HARD (15403-15405)=18/45/90. rp = base + difficultyBonus * (score / revision) ^ exponent; the exponent is not in any table.

packs._why: KEPT FROM SSOMG: LOONA's tables have no pack odds (the shop's odds button opened the manifest's ProbabilityUrl web page, sslo-portal.dalcomsoft.net, gone). CardStoreData has the same packs and prices as SSOMG: normal 5/10/30 for 5,000/10,000/30,000 RP, premium 5/10/30 for 50/90/240 diamonds. LOONA has no prism cards (CardData.prism is empty), so no prism packs. Odds per grade; 'guarantee' = at least N cards of at least that grade per pack size.

firstClear._why: KEPT FROM SSOMG: no first-clear reward table in LOONA either (the client's firstClearReward is server data). Per song and difficulty: one card from the song's group, grade by difficulty, plus some RP (the result screen hangs when a song's rewards are only card packs).

songMilestones._why: LOONA's MissionData, mapped like SSOMG's and SSGF's: every 5 songs = the daily RP (code 2 song play II 1,000 + code 3 power up 1,500) + the daily card-purchase card (code 4: B grade, as in SSOMG); every 20 = weekly all-clear 50 diamonds (code 15) + weekly card-purchase A card (code 13); every 50 = weekly power-up 10,000 RP (code 12) + 5-day all-clear S card (code 14). Left out as in SSOMG/SSGF: ads (codes 0, 10), 3 headphones (code 1), daily all-clear A card (code 5), weekly 20 songs 5,000 RP (code 11).

recordLadder._why: LOONA's MyRecordData, last month's tiers (codes 136-140, 2024-04; same every month since at least 2024-01), run once, counts distinct songs cleared (clearMusicMin 1/7/13/19/25). Per tier: pack (icon1 210 = normal 10-pack, 213-215 = premium 5/10/30-pack) + diamonds (icon2 202) + RP (icon3 201). Identical to SSOMG's ladder.

gradeUp._why: Two cards of the same member and grade, both at max level, become one card of the next grade (same member, level 1). Max levels from LOONA's GameConfigData MAX_CARD_LEVEL (10101)=5, MAX_R_CARD_LEVEL (10102)=50 (CardBalanceData/CardIntensifyData/CardGradeBonusData/CardSellData are identical to SSOMG's). Cost not in the tables; RP = CardSellData sell price of the two cards.
